[[Gilneas City]] | status = Killable }} '''Greymane Workers''' are humans found in the [[Dryrock Pit]] and at [[Freyshear Keep]] in [[Gilneas]], and within [[Gilneas City]]. ==Quotes== * You won't leave here alive, outsider! * You will find no mercy here, just the wrath of Greymane. * You will die before the might of Gilneas. * I fight for my king, you fight for your life! * In the name of Genn Greymane! * You and the other rebels will be hunted like the cattle you are. * For the Crown! * My sword is stained with the blood of my enemies, and yours will soon join them. ==Objective of== * Drops [[Vial of Blood]] for {{questlong|Alliance|42|Vilest of Men}}. * Drops [[Greymane Signet]] for {{questlong|Horde|45|Greymane Hatred}}. ==Patch changes== * {{Patch|1.17.0|note=Added.}} [[Category:Human characters]] [[Category:Gilneas mobs]] [[Category:Gilneas City mobs]]
